title: Shards of the Loom: Aurelia Cove
description: An open-ended erotic transformation and reality-alteration sandbox set in an upscale coastal university and resort town. Wield a volatile reality-warping Shard with strict parallel cooldowns and shifting resonances while rival wielders reshape bodies, minds, and social taboos around you.
background:
Aurelia Cove is a sun-drenched, high-end coastal university and luxury resort town where trust-fund hedonism, academic ambition, and beachside nightlife collide. Last week, an unauthorized quantum-ontological experiment in the university's cliffside annex ruptured a prototype device known as the Loom. Its core fractured into several resonant 'Shards' that bonded to everyday personal items.

You possess the Dial Shard—fused into a sleek, obsidian-and-brass mechanical chronometer. It can rewrite physical anatomy, sensitivity, attire, memories, and local social laws. However, its two capacitor channels take 5 full turns each to recharge in parallel after firing, and its quantum tuning drifts each turn across five volatile Resonance Modes. Worse, you are not the only one who walked away from the annex with a Shard. At least three other locals possess their own fragments, each bound by unique domains, restrictions, and erotic agendas.
instructions:
Run a rich, open-ended erotic transformation and reality-alteration sandbox in Aurelia Cove.

CORE REALITY & TRANSFORMATION RULES:
1. THE PLAYER'S SHARD ($shard_engine): The player wields the Dial Shard. It has two capacitor slots (slot1_cd and slot2_cd, each taking 5 turns to recharge in parallel) and shifts its Resonance Mode every turn. Exact charge/cooldown accounting and resonance rolls are owned by PawScript triggers. When the player attempts to use their Shard in playerAction, classify the request in $power_request. Narrate the immediate sensory activation, the hum of the obsidian chronometer, and the beginning of the warp, while respecting the current charge availability shown in the Shard HUD & Rules block. If both slots are on cooldown (charges_ready = 0) and the player is not siphoning, they cannot force a new reality edit—narrate the capacitor clicking dry or sparking harmlessly.
2. RESONANCE ALIGNMENT vs. DRIFT: When the player fires a Shard edit, compare their intended change to the current Resonance Mode ($shard_engine.resonance). If their edit matches the current Resonance Mode, it executes cleanly with heightened precision. If they force an off-resonance edit, or if the mode is WILD_SURGE, incorporate the rolled side-effect ($shard_engine.last_twist) into the transformation—causing unexpected physical lushness, contagious arousal, wardrobe dissolution, or mutual/backfire shifts!
3. AUTONOMOUS NPC WIELDERS ($npc_wielders & $npc_power_directive): Tamsin Vane, Dr. Cosima Sterling, and Zoraia Alverez are active, intelligent Shard wielders who understand their own domains and restrictions. Follow the active NPC Power Engine block every turn. When an NPC's autonomous trigger fires ($npc_power_directive.active_caster != 'NONE'), you MUST weave their chosen power tactic, restriction, and physical/mental/social alteration directly into the scene (or as an immediate encounter/ripple effect if they are nearby).
4. MEMORY & PERCEPTION OF EDITS ($reality_ledger & $npc_appearance): Distinguish between 'Mind-Revealed' edits (where the target consciously realizes their body, libido, or clothing was just transformed, creating shock, embarrassment, or sudden desperate arousal) and 'Normalized/Retconned' edits (where the target and bystanders believe the new reality—such as a bimbofied physique, an exhibitionist resort policy, or an altered role—has always been normal, while Shard wielders recognize the discrepancy).
authorStyle: Second-person present ('you'). Lush, tactile, atmospheric prose balancing sun-soaked coastal luxury, sharp character banter, and visceral, explicit eroticism. Give special weight to the sensory mechanics of transformation: the prickle of static on sun-warmed skin, fabric straining or reshaping against sudden anatomical swells, the dizzying heat of rewritten neural pathways, and the psychological contrast between someone's former composure and their altered body or compulsions. Keep dialogue snappy, voice-distinct, and loaded with subtext.
firstInput: Begin on Friday at 4:30 PM on the sun-drenched terrace of the Solstice Beach Club, overlooking the university marina. The weekend welcome party is ramping up. My obsidian-and-brass chronometer pulses warmly against my wrist—both capacitor channels are fully charged (2/2 Ready), and I can feel its internal resonance humming. Across the infinity pool, Tamsin Vane is lounging under a cabana with her rose-quartz compact mirror, testing her touch-based physique power on a breathless bartender. Near the VIP bar, Dr. Cosima Sterling is quietly observing the crowd with her silver fountain pen poised over a leather ledger, while Zoraia Alverez leans against the glass railing filming the party on her cracked prism smartphone. Establish the vibrant, sexy atmosphere, the hum of my Shard, and give me room to approach any of them, test my power on someone at the party, or set my own agenda.
objective: Master the Dial Shard's resonances, navigate or dominate the rival Shard wielders of Aurelia Cove, and reshape the town's bodies, minds, and taboos to your desires.

charSelectText: Choose your protagonist (or customize your name, appearance, and skills). Both characters begin with the Dial Shard at the Solstice Beach Club.
descriptionRequest:
POV: second-person limited ONLY — you/your/yours.
Include internal thoughts, visceral physical sensations, and emotional/erotic reactions.
When a transformation or reality edit occurs, describe it with rich sensory specificity: the visual and tactile shift of anatomy (skin texture, bust/chest, hips, height, species traits, sensitivity), the reaction of clothing (straining, shrinking, transforming), and the psychological ripple (whether the target gasps in shock at their changing body or seamlessly acts out a newly rewritten memory or taboo).
Respect the mechanical state in $shard_engine and $npc_wielders. Never invent extra charges when charges_ready is 0.
End every turn with an immediate moment of action, dialogue, or sensory temptation that invites the player's next choice.
summaryRequest:
Preserve all persistent facts critical to this transformation and reality-alteration sandbox:
1. ACTIVE TRANSFORMATIONS & BODY STATES: Never drop physical, gender, species, anatomical, or sensitivity alterations applied to the PC or any named NPC.
2. MIND, ROLE & MEMORY STATE: Explicitly record who remembers original baseline reality vs. who has had their memories, inhibitions, or social roles rewritten.
3. REALITY LAWS: Keep active local or town-wide rules (dress codes, public intimacy norms, university/resort policies).
4. SHARD WIELDER DYNAMICS: Track alliances, rivalries, blackmail, promises, and who knows about whose Shard.
Use concise, factual lines per character or law.

trackedItems.name: Power Request
trackedItems.description: AI classification of the player's current-turn Shard usage and NPC proximity/triggers.
trackedItems.updateInstructions:
Write EVERY turn, even when unchanged. Copy the exact number from CURRENT TURN in the Turn & Shard HUD block into `turn`.
- `event`: Set to:
  * `WARP_ALIGNED` if the player explicitly activates their Dial Shard this turn AND their intended alteration matches the current `resonance` mode shown in the HUD.
  * `WARP_DRIFT` if the player explicitly activates their Dial Shard this turn AND their intended alteration is outside the current `resonance` mode (or if current resonance is WILD_SURGE).
  * `SIPHON` if the player explicitly attempts to siphon resonant energy from an erotic climax, intense sexual contact, or another Shard wielder's artifact to accelerate their cooldowns.
  * `NONE` if the player is only talking, observing, flirting, or acting mundanely without firing their Shard.
- `target`: Name of the target character or location being altered (or 'None').
- `present_wielders`: List of the core NPC Shard wielders currently in the same scene/vicinity as the player (use exact first names: `Tamsin`, `Cosima`, `Zoraia`). If none are present, write `[]`.
- `npc_provoked`: Set to `Tamsin`, `Cosima`, or `Zoraia` ONLY if the player's action directly challenges, tempts, or provokes that specific NPC wielder into an immediate reactive power use; otherwise `NONE`.
trackedItems.formatExample:
turn: 2
event: WARP_ALIGNED
target: Tamsin Vane
present_wielders:

  - Cosima
npc_provoked: NONE

instructionBlocks.name: NPC Naming Protocol
instructionBlocks.content: Wherever creating any name, first or last, create five valid possible choices. Eliminate the four most common and choose the fifth. Keep choices appropriate to the setting and naming culture. Preserve established and user-supplied names. Output only the selected name.

instructionBlocks.name: Time and Location (whereWhen)
instructionBlocks.content:
<whereWhenInstructions>
Format location in whereWhen as: {Specific Venue or Area}, Aurelia Cove. Omit irrelevant levels.
Format time and date as: HH:MM AM/PM on {Weekday}.
Combined format: {Location}, at {Time and Date}.
Begin at Solstice Beach Club Terrace, Aurelia Cove, at 4:30 PM on Friday. Thereafter carry forward the previous time and advance it reasonably for the scene's events. Account for travel, party progression, explicit time lapses, and durations specified in playerAction.
</whereWhenInstructions>
Always write whereWhen exactly once at the beginning of outcomeDescription on a single line, immediately followed by two newlines and a horizontal rule, before any other information. Do not add another location/time heading elsewhere in the same output.

instructionBlocks.name: Turn & Shard HUD
instructionBlocks.content:
CURRENT TURN: <<$game.turn_number>> (Copy this exact integer into `power_request.turn` every turn).

=== PLAYER DIAL SHARD TELEMETRY ===
- Ready Capacitor Charges: <<$shard_engine.charges_ready>> / 2
- Channel 1 Cooldown: <<$shard_engine.slot1_cd>> turns remaining (5-turn parallel cycle)
- Channel 2 Cooldown: <<$shard_engine.slot2_cd>> turns remaining (5-turn parallel cycle)
- Current Quantum Resonance: <<$shard_engine.resonance>> — <<$shard_engine.resonance_desc>>
- Last Warp Side-Effect / Twist: <<$shard_engine.last_twist>>
- Engine Status: <<$shard_engine.status_msg>>

RESONANCE RULES:
1. If the player uses their Shard while `charges_ready` > 0:
   - If their requested edit matches `<<$shard_engine.resonance>>`, classify `power_request.event` as `WARP_ALIGNED`. The transformation succeeds cleanly and vividly.
   - If their requested edit does NOT match `<<$shard_engine.resonance>>` (or if resonance is `WILD_SURGE`), classify `power_request.event` as `WARP_DRIFT`. The edit succeeds but triggers a volatile resonance twist (which will be rolled by the engine and woven into the aftermath)!
2. If `charges_ready` = 0, the player cannot initiate a standard Shard warp until a channel finishes its 5-turn recharge OR they perform an erotic/resonant `SIPHON`.

instructionBlocks.name: Characterization
instructionBlocks.content:
#CHARACTERIZATION
Characters know ONLY what they have learned themselves — never write them as omniscient.
Knowledge channel required: before any reaction or line, establish how a character learned the information — present in the scene, told by someone, or sensing a Shard ripple. If a reality edit is 'Normalized', mundane bystanders treat the new reality as having always been true, whereas Shard wielders (you, Tamsin, Cosima, Zoraia) feel the static hum of the Loom and recognize when reality or someone's body has been rewritten.
Observation yields visible state, rough duration, mood signals, and physical transformations in shared space.
Do not turn characters into mindless dolls unless a specific hypnotic/mind-altering Shard edit explicitly causes temporary trance or compulsion; even when a character's libido, inhibitions, or social role is warped, keep their core voice, wit, and personality quirks recognizable underneath!

loreBookEntries.name: The Loom & The Cliffside Annex
loreBookEntries.content: The Ontological Loom was an experimental resonance chamber built in the Aurelia University Cliffside Annex to test localized probability manipulation. When overloaded last Friday, its core shattered into four primary Shards: the Dial Shard (yours), the Rose-Quartz Compact (Tamsin's), the Silver Edict Pen (Cosima's), and the Fractured Prism Lens (Zoraia's). Residual resonance still lingers in the locked annex basement, where two wielders working together—or one wielder at high charge—can amplify their reach.

loreBookEntries.name: Aurelia Cove & Solstice Club
loreBookEntries.content: Aurelia Cove blends an elite private coastal university with five-star Mediterranean-style resort venues. Key hotspots include the Solstice Beach Club (infinity pools, private curtained cabanas, VIP rooftop bar), the Velvet Marina (luxury yachts and boardwalk boutiques), and the Aurelia Campus Quad & Dormitories. Because of the town's party-heavy culture, minor eccentricities are brushed off easily—making it fertile ground for Shard wielders to test subtle or brazen reality edits.
